items.finding: 59.6% of category-months fall in the group: missed target.
items.evidence: 124 of 208 category-months; total shortfall against target across all months is 3,270,661.
items.action: Review the listed categories first in this week's trading meeting.

items.finding: Contribution margin ranges from 21.8% in Apparel to 38.5% in Beauty & Wellness.
items.evidence: Margin is contribution profit divided by net revenue over all months.
items.action: Shift marketing budget from Apparel toward Beauty & Wellness where traffic allows.

items.finding: Home & Living has the largest cumulative gap to target.
items.evidence: Net revenue 13,124,542 against target 14,113,821, a gap of 989,279.
items.action: Set a recovery plan for Home & Living with traffic and price actions.

items.finding: The risk model ranks log_revenue_target, Category_Tech Accessories, Category_Home & Living as its main signals.
items.evidence: Logistic Regression, held-out AUC 0.83 on 52 rows; better than the naive baseline.
items.action: Watch these measures weekly for early warning.

items.finding: High Returns is the most common alert in the latest month.
items.action: Review product pages and sizing guidance.

items.finding: Category-months with repeated stockouts show a different at-risk rate.
items.evidence: At-risk rate 100.0% with 3 or more stockout days (2 rows) against 59.2% otherwise (206 rows).
items.action: Bring reorder points forward for categories that stock out twice in a quarter.

items.finding: The lowest quarter of health scores holds most of the at-risk months.
items.evidence: At-risk rate 92.3% in the lowest quarter (52 rows) against 48.7% in the rest.
items.action: Use the health score to rank the weekly review list.

items.finding: Months with the deepest discounts are linked with a different at-risk rate.
items.evidence: At-risk rate 46.2% in the top discount quarter (52 rows) against 64.1% elsewhere (156 rows).
items.action: Cap discount depth for categories that sit in the top quarter.

items.finding: 17 category-months behave unusually, most often in Apparel.
items.evidence: 8.2% of rows flagged; at-risk rate among them 47.1%.
items.action: Check the flagged months for data errors or one-off events.

items.finding: Home & Living has the weakest checkout completion.
items.evidence: Average completion 51.5% against 55.1% for the whole store.
items.action: Test a shorter checkout and cart reminders for Home & Living.

items.finding: Apparel has the highest average return rate.
items.action: Review product descriptions and sizing for Apparel.
